name: Hindsite
bio: HindSite is a Los Angeles-area Top 40 cover band that has been playing since 1998. Its sets take in pop, R&B, Latin music and hip-hop, and it plays weddings and events as well as club shows.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from @hindsiteband and thenextshow.com.
source: public web search and the band's public Instagram profile, 2026-10-29
